objective_value: <float> Total penalty from unmet shift requests and staffing coverage deviations.

solution.schedule: <dict, key: '{nurse_id}', value: dict with key '{day}'> Shift type assigned to each nurse on each day, or null if the nurse is not working that day.
solution.coverage_under: <dict, key: '{day}_{shift_type}'> Number of nurses below the preferred staffing level for each day and shift type with under-coverage.
solution.coverage_over: <dict, key: '{day}_{shift_type}'> Number of nurses above the preferred staffing level for each day and shift type with over-coverage.
